Feature: Is there an overt marker for the absolutive?
curated_comment: Georgian (nucl1302, ISO kat, Kartvelian) shows a classic tense-conditioned split-ergative system described in Hewitt (1990/1995). Ergative alignment appears in Series II contexts (perfective, past, indicative past, non-main): GB409_7-8=1, GB409_10-12=1 (when in Series II), GB409_16-21=1. Nominative-accusative alignment holds in Series I (imperfective, non-past, irrealis): GB409_6=0, GB409_9=0, GB409_13=0. 1st/2nd person pronouns are invariant (GB409_2-3=0). Inanimate agents can take ergative with causative semantics (GB409_19=1, with caveat noted). GB409_22=0 (no additional conditioning beyond the tense-series split). All 24 features documented and internally consistent. Note: the PDF in the folder is the 1995 second volume; source citations reference Hewitt (1990) which is the first edition; both are the same reference grammar. Glottocode nucl1302 is correct; the previously proposed geon1241 does not exist in Glottolog.

Feature: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the context of a non-agentive A?
Comment: Non-agentive A takes ergative marking in Series II. Hewitt (1990, pp.187-189) provides multiple examples of inanimate/abstract agents with no volitional control taking the ergative case: sun-ERG (dried the field), sweat-ERG (penetrated the shirt), pleasure-ERG (made me dizzy), God-ERG (let you grow old), illness-ERG (weakened the man’s knees). These are Series II constructions and therefore take the ergative. Original annotation (value=0) was a coding error directly contradicted by the examples cited in the same comment.

Feature: Is ergative alignment of flagging conditioned by any other factor?
Comment:
No se menciona algun otro factor que condicione la marca de caso de ergatividad. Sin embargo en Hewitt:1990, 446-490 se muestran algunos verbos irregulares. Donde se destaca el caso de "know", que historicamente pertenece a la serie II. Y del cual se extrajo un ejemplo de otro fragmento

gmrot-mav (0-)i-c-i-s God-ERG (3rd.PER-)SV-know--PRS.INDIC-he ‘God knows

En el cual, se usa know asociado al sujeto (gmrot) con marca ergativa (mav) pero en presente tercera persona, fuera de la Serie II

Feature: Are the ergative and the genitive expressed by the same marker?
Comment: En general se usa -ma/-n como marca de Ergativo mientras que se usa -s e -is para genitivo.

Feature: Are the ergative and the instrumental/comitative expressed by the same marker?
